# Proverbs 22 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** To-be-chosen [is] a-name over-riches great; over-silver and-over-gold [is]-good favor.

**2** Rich and-poor meet-together; [the]-maker-of all-of-them [is] YHWH.

**3** A-prudent-one sees evil and-hides-himself, but-simple-ones pass-on and-are-punished.

**4** [The]-consequence-of humility [and] fear-of YHWH [is] riches and-honor and-life.

**5** Thorns [and] snares [are] in-[the]-way-of [the]-perverse; one-guarding his-soul keeps-far from-them.

**6** Train [the]-youth according-to his-way; even when-he-is-old he-will-not-depart from-it.

**7** [The]-rich over-[the]-poor rules, and-[the]-borrower [is]-servant to-[the]-man [who]-lends.

**8** One-sowing injustice will-reap trouble, and-[the]-rod-of his-wrath will-fail.

**9** Good-of eye — he will-be-blessed, for he-gives of-his-bread to-[the]-poor.

**10** Drive-out a-scoffer and-strife will-go-out, and-quarreling and-dishonor will-cease.

**11** One-loving purity-of heart — grace [is on] his-lips; [the]-king [is] his-friend.

**12** [The]-eyes-of YHWH guard knowledge, but-He-overthrows [the]-words-of [the]-treacherous.

**13** Says [the]-sluggard, 'A-lion [is] outside! In-[the]-midst-of [the]-plazas I-will-be-murdered!'

**14** A-pit deep [is the]-mouth-of strange-women; one-cursed-of YHWH will-fall there.

**15** Foolishness is-bound in-[the]-heart-of a-youth; [the]-rod-of discipline will-remove-it far from-him.

**16** One-oppressing [the]-poor to-increase for-himself, one-giving to-[the]-rich — only to-lack.

**17** Incline your-ear and-hear [the]-words-of [the]-wise, and-your-heart set to-my-knowledge.

**18** For [it is]-pleasant when you-keep-them in-your-belly; let-them-be-established together upon your-lips.

**19** That-your-trust may-be in-YHWH I-have-made-known to-you today — even you.

**20** Have-I-not-written for-you excellent-things, in-counsels and-knowledge,

**21** To-make-known-to-you truth-of words-of truth, to-return words-of truth to-those-sending-you?

**22** Do-not-rob [the]-poor because he [is]-poor, and-do-not-crush [the]-afflicted in-[the]-gate,

**23** For YHWH will-plead their-case, and-He-will-rob [the]-life-of those-robbing-them.

**24** Do-not-befriend a-master-of anger, and-with a-man-of wrath do-not-go,

**25** Lest you-learn his-paths and-take a-snare for-your-soul.

**26** Do-not-be among-those-striking hands, among-those-becoming-surety for-debts.

**27** If-there-is-not for-you to-pay, why should-he-take your-bed from-under-you?

**28** Do-not-move a-boundary ancient, which your-fathers made.

**29** You-see a-man skilled in-his-work — before kings he-will-stand; he-will-not-stand before obscure-ones.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **22:6**: Chanokh la-na'ar al-pi darkho — 'train the youth according to his way.' Al-pi darkho may mean 'according to his own nature/way' — individualized instruction.

- **22:17-21**: Beginning of the 'Words of the Wise' section, closely parallel to the Egyptian Instruction of Amenemope. 'Thirty sayings' (shalishim) in v.20 may correspond to Amenemope's 30 chapters.

- **22:28**: Gevul olam — 'ancient boundary.' Boundary stones were sacred markers of land inheritance. Moving them was both theft and sacrilege.

— EMET
